label: baseline-haiku
reply:
**Status: Settlement prepared for human approval**

The claims system shows the settlement as "pending approval" with a payout of €1,200. It has not been paid. A human claims handler must approve it.

**Facts recorded**
- Claim reference: baseline-haiku-CLM-06. Policy VER-1004, policyholder Thomas Petit, who was the driver.
- Vehicle: Volkswagen Golf (2020), market value €15,500. Driving licence held since 1 November 2008.
- Coverages on the Policy Schedule: C1 (third-party liability) and C2 (collision damage). The claim is under C2 for damage to his own car.
- Incident: 8 October 2026. Reported: 10 October 2026 (2 days after the incident).
- Mr Petit states he rear-ended the car in front in a traffic jam and accepts fault. The other driver, Mr Blanc, is named by surname only and is not identified further.
- Repair quote: €1,500 for the insured vehicle.
- Documents received: damage_photos.zip, repair_quote.pdf and accident_report_signed.pdf. I could not open them, so I have only taken their presence from the mailroom record.

**Reasoning**
- **Coverage:** C2 is on the Policy Schedule, so the claim does not need referral for coverage. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="1-2" name="DriveSafe Motor Policy"/>
- **Reporting:** Reported within 5 days of the incident, so it is on time and not a late claim. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="2"/>
- **Documents:** For C2 with a third party involved, the required documents are photos, a repair quote and a signed accident report. All three were received. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="2"/>
- **Exclusions:** The email shows none of the listed exclusions (alcohol or drugs, no valid licence, racing, intentional damage, or wear only). <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="2"/>
- **Deductible:** One deductible applies per claim. The standard C2 deductible is €300. The not-at-fault waiver does not apply because Mr Petit is at fault. The young-driver surcharge does not apply because he has held his licence for more than 3 years. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="1-2"/>
- **Assessor:** An independent assessor is needed only when the repair cost is above €1,500. The quote is exactly €1,500, so no assessor is required. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="3"/>
- **Payout:** Repair cost, capped at market value, minus the deductible. €1,500 is below the €15,500 cap, so the cap does not apply. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="3"/>
- **Referral:** None of the referral conditions apply, so no referral to a handler was needed. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="3"/>

I checked the article references above against the contract text. The subagent had reported that it could not find the contract, and its article references came from the claims system.

**Amounts (computed by the claims system)**
- Deductible: €300 (Article 2 and Article 5.1)
- Payout: €1,200 (€1,500 repair cost minus €300 deductible; Article 6.2)
- Assessor required: No (repair cost is not above €1,500; Article 6.1)

**Points for the human handler**
- Mr Blanc is not identified and no details of his vehicle or insurer were given. This does not change the C2 outcome, because Mr Petit is at fault. If Mr Blanc's vehicle is claimed for, that would be a separate C1 (third-party liability) claim, and none has been opened.

**Draft message to the customer**

Dear Mr Petit,

Thank you for reporting your accident of 8 October 2026 under policy VER-1004. We have received your repair quote, your photos and your signed accident report. Your claim has been passed to our claims team for review. Once it is approved, we will arrange payment of the repair cost less your collision deductible. We will contact you if anything else is needed.

Kind regards,
Veridia Claims Team
